metadata.short_desc: Session and global ban list management.
metadata.desc: A ban list plugin that blocks chosen users from using the bot within a session or globally. Administrators can ban or unban users with commands; run ban-help for a quick guide.

enable.hint: When off, the blacklist stops applying immediately but the records are kept; same as /ban-disable

cache_ttl.hint: How long the record files stay cached: lower uses less memory, higher reads the disk less. Restart the plugin to apply.

errors.notFound: Record not found; it may have expired
errors.recordMissing: Record not found; it may have expired
errors.sessionRecordMissing: Session record not found; it may have expired
errors.durationType: Duration must be a number or a duration string
errors.durationTooLong: Duration is too long; 10 years at most
errors.reasonTooLong: Reason is too long (at most {max} characters)
errors.deltaType: The adjustment must be a number of seconds
errors.deltaZero: The adjustment cannot be 0; use the delete action to remove a record
errors.deltaTooLarge: The adjustment is too large; 10 years at most
errors.kindInvalid: kind must be ban or pass
errors.scopeInvalid: scope must be session or global
errors.targetInvalid: target must be user or session
errors.globalSessionUnsupported: A session record cannot be global
errors.permanentRecord: This record is permanent, so it cannot be adjusted (delete it instead)
errors.passNeedsBan: This user is not banned, so there is nothing to exempt. Create a ban first, or check the scope.
errors.passNeedsSessionBan: This session is not banned, so there is nothing to exempt. Ban the session first, or use a per-user action instead.

reneban.title: Ban List Console
reneban.description: Inspect and manage session and global ban / exemption records
reneban.heading: Ban List Console
reneban.subtitle: One place to review and maintain session and global ban records
reneban.emptyHint: No banned users or sessions right now
reneban.search: Search user ID, session or reason
reneban.enableHint: Same as /ban-enable and /ban-disable; reset on restart
reneban.confirmEnableBody: The blacklist takes effect immediately: listed users will no longer get a response from the bot.
reneban.confirmDisableBody: The blacklist stops applying immediately: listed users regain access, and the records are kept.
reneban.enableConfirmNote: Identical to /ban-enable and /ban-disable; the config value is restored on restart.
reneban.timelineHint: Sorted by expiry, at most 8 entries
reneban.dialogResetUserTitle: Reset all records of a user
reneban.dialogResetSessionTitle: Reset all records of a session
reneban.durationHint: Format: 1d2h30m (d days / h hours / m minutes / s seconds); empty or 0 means permanent
reneban.deltaHint: In seconds; negative values shorten the record
reneban.confirmDelete: Delete this record? This cannot be undone.
reneban.confirmResetUser: This clears every ban and exemption record of the user. Continue?
reneban.confirmResetSession: This clears every record of the session. Continue?
reneban.fieldRequired: Please fill in the required fields
reneban.histHint: Bucketed by remaining time; permanent records excluded
reneban.heatHint: 3 hours per cell; darker means more records expiring
reneban.heatAxisHint: columns = day, rows = time of day
